items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: you were doing something with a Coltrane matrix

ctx.x: The modes. And then you said you were doing something with a Coltrane matrix. So I think my question here is have you ever written anything, or have your students written anything that has no seemingly recognizable form or technique or chord structure but it sounds good and you don’t know why?

I’m not sure about my students. I find — that’s a really tough question. I mean form is something, it’s kind of the philosophy of what is composition. A philosophy in composition is describing form and manipulating form and creating form. Sometimes, it’s like everything else, it’s all been done. You know what I mean? Everything’s been done, we’re going to just start repeating over and over what’s been done and maybe something we can add on to it. Much like twelve tone ruined classical music. Are we going to do…
